title: An open gate for a later stage blocks every advance (#237)
symptom: chough stage advance is refused with refused:awaiting-human at build while the only open gate is a release decision
trigger: Open a human gate meant for release while the session is at build, then advance
expected: build, test and accept advance as usual; only the move out of release waits for the gate
actual: every advance and skip is refused while any gate is open, so a pending release or publication decision stops build, test and accept
steps: chough stage advance (three times, to build)
impact: Agents clear real gates to keep working, or stall; the release decision has no place to wait (GitHub #237)
source: GitHub issue #237; red on 0.5.0 at leif/0.6.0-237-red 018412c8

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: The verified bug is the opposite defect: gates were ignored and advance went through. This one is the fix's overreach: every gate refuses every move, including gates that hold a later stage.

status: open -> verified. Fixed by plan step 6 (PR #238, f70f5727): a gate holds the stage it names (--holds, default the current stage), and advance and skip are refused only out of a stage an open gate holds. TC-cli-237-gate-holds-its-stage passed on the 0.6.0 branch after its 0.5.0 failure.
